scope: Original local non-generic two-variant enums, shared payload receivers and local method signatures; advisory capabilities independent of strict pair admission. No automatic rewrite/purity claim.

cases.reason: Original exhaustive arms call distinct local inherent methods on corresponding payloads with shared receiver/u32 signature. Beta closure body cannot block signature-based proposal.

invariants: Existing trait suppression requires exact resolved owner/member relation, never names alone.
Opaque callee bodies do not poison available source/signature evidence for this advisory consumer.
Ordinary functions/methods without candidate top-level match are evaluated-no-finding, not unsupported because of unrelated body constructs.
Missing R0 original source ownership is unavailable, never an empty complete result.
Incomplete candidate assessment exits2; findings can coexist with incomplete scope.
Reports have exact assessed/expected function denominators where capture knows the population.
No legacy engine is retired by these bounded cases.
